reports.module.name: Reports
reports.module.description: Ready-made reports that read every module's figures live: tickets, takings and attendance by performance, production or season.
reports.navigation.reports.label: Reports
reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Figures from across the theatre, read as you open them. Each figure shows only if you may see it in its own module.
reports.empty-description: Reports appear here when a module that offers them is switched on and you may see its figures.
reports.choose-description: The figures are read as soon as you choose.
reports.nothing: Nothing to show for these dates.
reports.hidden.one: 1 figure is hidden because you do not have access to it.
reports.hidden.other: {count} figures are hidden because you do not have access to them.
reports.chart-summary: A bar for each row of the table showing {figure}; the most is {most}.
reports.unavailable.failed: It could not be read just now.
reports.unavailable.too-slow: It took too long to read.
reports.unavailable.bad-answer: Its module answered in a way Reports cannot show.
reports.unavailable.hidden: You do not have access to it here.
reports.unavailable.unsupported: It cannot be broken down this way.
reports.abilities.report.view.label: Read reports
reports.abilities.people.view.label: Read figures about individual people
reports.navigation.runs.label: Saved copies
reports.abilities.run.view.label: Open and download copies of reports
reports.abilities.run.export.label: Download copies of reports as CSV
reports.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change how Reports keeps copies
reports.settings.runs.keep-for.label: Keep copies for
reports.settings.runs.keep-for.help: How long a copy of a report and its files are kept. Long enough for a new committee to see the last committee's copies.
reports.settings.runs.row-limit.label: Largest copy
reports.settings.runs.row-limit.help: The most rows one copy may hold. A larger one fails with advice to choose a coarser breakdown or a shorter period.
reports.csv.question: Question
reports.copy.kept-description: It will be in Saved copies in a moment.
reports.runs.title: Saved copies
reports.runs.description: Copies of reports kept as they stood when they were made.
reports.runs.empty-description: Open a report and choose Keep a copy to keep its figures as they stand.
reports.runs.working-description: Reading each figure. This page updates when it is ready.
reports.runs.failed: This copy could not be made
reports.runs.failures.too-large: It would have too many rows. Choose a coarser breakdown or a shorter period, and make a new copy.
reports.runs.failures.other: Something went wrong while reading its figures. Make a new copy from the report.
reports.runs.expired-description: Its figures are no longer kept. Open the report to see them as they stand now.
reports.gone.one: 1 figure in this report is no longer offered, so its column is left out.
reports.gone.other: {count} figures in this report are no longer offered, so their columns are left out.
reports.unavailable.no-value: Cannot be worked out here, such as a division by nought.
reports.unavailable.gone: This figure is no longer offered.
reports.saved.title: Your reports
reports.abilities.report.create.label: Make their own reports
reports.abilities.report.manage.label: Manage everyone's saved reports
reports.settings.builder.max-columns.lab: Most columns in a report's table
reports.settings.builder.max-columns.hel: A copy of a report whose pivot would make a wider table than this is refused, so it still opens on a phone and in a spreadsheet.
reports.builder.name: Name
reports.builder.columns-help: Figures from any module, and formulas that work them out. A formula names earlier columns as C1, C2 and so on.
reports.builder.order-keys: Press Space to pick up, the arrow keys to move, and Space again to drop. Formulas are renumbered to match.
reports.builder.across-by-help: Repeats every column under each value, with totals last.
reports.builder.question: What it asks about
reports.builder.scope-id-help: Optional. The report opens on it, and anyone can choose another.
reports.builder.share-help: Everyone holding the role can open it. Each still sees only the figures they may see.
reports.builder.formula-help: Use + − × ÷, brackets, whole numbers and earlier columns: {columns}.
reports.people.name: Name
reports.people.personal-data: Contains personal data: do not forward
reports.unavailable.no-total: This figure has no total of its own, so people are not added up.
reports.abilities.people.export.label: Download reports about named people
reports.settings.people.keep-for.label: How long copies of reports about people are kept
reports.settings.people.keep-for.help: After this, a copy's rows about each person are deleted and the copy says it has expired.
reports.people.banner: This report shows figures about named people. Opening it is recorded.
reports.people.none: Nobody has a figure for these dates.
reports.people.kept-description: It names people, so it is kept for a short time only.
reports.people.stale: Some people in this copy have since been merged. Re-run to combine merged people.
reports.builder.kind-help: A report about named people shows up to 6 figures per person. It is never shared, and every opening is recorded.
